insights: NVIDIA cut Nemotron 3 Ultra’s price by 33%, dropping from $1.60 to $1.07 per million tokens. No new models or intelligence shifts were recorded, and the frontier ranking held steady. Inflection removed two models in the None-intelligence tier (Inflection 3 Pi and Inflection 3 Productivity, each $5.00), and OpenAI removed GPT-4o-mini Search Preview ($0.300). On the speed front, Devstral Small 2 gained 40% to 28 t/s, while Qwen3.5 4B slowed 34% to 27 t/s, NVIDIA Nemotron Nano 12B v2 VL jumped 28% to 83 t/s, and both Llama 3.2 11B Vision and Mistral Medium 3.5 dropped 25% to 6 t/s and 63 t/s respectively.
